title: Onboard nebula-14b v1.0: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Priya Shah
description: Motivation: Add 'nebula-14b v1.0' to the model registry with initial metadata, validated performance profiles for typical sequence lengths, and automated changelog/release note generation. This PR bundles three tightly related pieces: 1) model metadata and manifest files required by the registry, 2) perf profiles generated from the benchmark harness (short/medium/long seq buckets) and quantization recommendations, and 3) a changelog automation hook so that onboarding entries are included in the release notes pipeline. Summary of changes: - Add model manifest (models/nebula/nebula-14b-v1.0/manifest.yaml) with architecture, tokenizer, weight source and license metadata. - Add perf profiles (perf_profiles/nebula-14b-v1.0/*.json) with latency/qps numbers collected from perf-canary runs across p4d and a100 configurations and recommended batch/kv-cache settings. - Update registry index and onboarding automation (scripts/changelog-gen and registry/automation) to pick up new model metadata and produce a draft release note in markdown. - Small SDK compatibility fixes: examples/nebula-quickstart.md and redwood-model-registry README updates. Checklist: - [x] Manifest schema validated against registry schema - [x] Perf profiles recorded and verified by perf-canary - [x] Changelog automation adds entry to draft release notes - [x] CI passes integration tests and schema linters - [x] Reviewed and approved by infra/perf reviewers Notes: Perf numbers are best-effort from internal canary runs (nightly job run 2024-10-22) and will be re-run in Dedicated capacity smoke tests. The changelog step is backward-compatible and gated behind the registry automation flag to avoid noise in early canaries.
